verdict.rationale: Airweave ships an official MCP server that lets assistants like Claude and Cursor search synced data, plus published skills for Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode that enable setup/search without re-explaining, all pointing to a single shared 'collection' as the underlying memory. Community evidence corroborates real-world use with Cursor. Missing for 10: explicit first-party ChatGPT connector docs and independent evidence of multiple assistants simultaneously sharing state in practice.
